talks.title: AI Hack Days 2026
talks.description: A free community event for developers to learn AI hands-on with workshops and hack sessions.

events.location: SSW Sydney, Neutral Bay, NSW, Australia

talks.title: EF Core Bench Lab – A Peek into the Black Box
talks.description: A practical performance deep-dive into EF Core internals, query costs, and benchmarking patterns.

events.location: Microsoft HQ - Brisbane, Level 28, 400 George Street, Brisbane, QLD, Australia

talks.title: Building Real AI Agents in Notion @ Brisbane
talks.description: Hosting a Brisbane Build Club session on AI agents from two angles: how Notion AI Agents plug intelligence into everyday workspaces, and the harness engineering that powers autonomous agent systems underneath. Live demos plus hands-on time for attendees who bring a laptop.

events.location: The Precinct, Level 2/315 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley, QLD, Australia

talks.title: From Vibe-Coded to Prod-Ready: Testing Your .NET Agents with MAF + AgentEval
talks.description: Workshop at AgentCamp 2026 Brisbane Edition. Hands-on session showing how to take a vibe-coded .NET agent and make it production-ready using Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) and AgentEval for systematic evaluation and testing.

events.location: QUT P Block, Gardens Point, Brisbane, QLD, Australia

talks.title: Optimising Vibe Coding - Ship Full-Stack AI Apps
talks.description: Hosting a Brisbane Build Club meetup exploring modern development workflows for Vibe Coders. Talks and live walkthroughs on rapidly building frontends, reliable backends, production-ready databases and AI agent orchestration — all without losing engineering fundamentals.

events.location: Launch Event Space, Fortitude Valley, QLD, Australia

talks.title: Judge — QUT AIML 2026 Hackathon
talks.description: Invited as one of 5 industry judges at QUT AI & ML Society's 2026 inaugural AIML Hackathon — QUT's biggest standalone student club hackathon to date. Reviewed 20 team pitches and live demos from 115+ participants across QUT and UQ, giving technical feedback on architecture, AI/ML choices, and product direction. Fellow judges: Gemma Lipovski and Lachlan Healey (NTI), Olaf Wrieden (Microsoft), Priyanka Shah (Avanade).

talks.title: MVP Summit 2026
talks.description: Exclusive annual multi-day Microsoft event for MVPs and Regional Directors, featuring hundreds of in-depth technical sessions, direct engagement with Microsoft product leadership and engineers, and networking with MVPs worldwide.

talks.title: Catching Up 2026 Q1 AI Trends @ Brisbane
talks.description: Hosting a Brisbane Build Club session catching up on the first few months of 2026 in AI: new models, agent frameworks, and developer tools reshaping how we build and ship. Talks on setting up OpenClaw locally, orchestrating Mastra.ai agents beyond the hello-world demo, and moving from vibe coding to software observability and reliability.

events.location: Launch Event Space, The Precinct, Fortitude Valley, QLD, Australia

talks.title: Safety and Guardrails in AI Coding @ Brisbane
talks.description: Hosting a Brisbane Build Club workshop on the risks hiding behind fast AI-generated code: hallucinations, security vulnerabilities, and logic flaws that traditional testing misses. Focused on practical patterns for validating LLM output before it ships.

events.location: Launch Event Space, The Precinct, Fortitude Valley, QLD, Australia

talks.title: AI Tools Experimentation Playground Workshop @ Brisbane
talks.description: Hosting a Brisbane Build Club workshop for side-by-side experimentation with AI tools — testing whether the newest hyped tools really 10× productivity, or whether well-used familiars like ChatGPT still hold their own. Shared insights from Sandra Arato, Adam Beaupeurt, and Damian Karzon alongside builder demos.

events.location: Launch Event Space, Level 3, The Precinct, Fortitude Valley, QLD, Australia
